issues.summary: Hook doc comment claims it is shared with the header /wallet-connect-scan scanner and a 'replace' mode exists for it, but no such caller exists at HEAD
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: useScannedAddressToSend.ts:20-25,57-71 describe a header-scanner consumer and 'replace' mode; grep shows only ScanQrSend.container.tsx:40 imports the hook and it never passes 'replace'. The comment is inaccurate and the branch is dead code, but it doesn't change runtime behaviour.

issues.summary: Rewritten ScanQrSend onScan has no container-level test
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: ScanQrSend.container.tsx:57-77 was rewritten (the guard/setIsCameraActive moved out of navigateToRecipient into onScan), and no ScanQrSend test exists in features/Send. Reverting or breaking this ordering would not fail any test.

issues.summary: Dedupe test doesn't check that a different value still toasts
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: useScannedAddressToSend.test.tsx:91-98 only calls with 'foo' twice and checks one call, so a single-boolean dedupe would still pass. The weakness is real, but the impact is small.

issues.summary: No test for a prefix with no active chain
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The inline condition at useScannedAddressToSend.ts:48 is never tested with a prefix and activeChain undefined. The tests at :72-89 always set shortName 'eth'. It's equivalent to the old isChainMismatch, so the risk is small.

issues.summary: ImportReadOnly useScan duplicates parse/validate/dedupe logic with a module-level dedupe map
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: features/ImportReadOnly/hooks/useScan/index.ts:10,38-54 does keep a module-level toastForValueShown and duplicates resolveScannedAddress logic. The file is untouched by this diff, so this is at most low.

issues.summary: Claim that the ImportReadOnly test mocks internals while the hook calls resolveScannedAddress
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: At HEAD, ImportReadOnly/hooks/useScan/index.ts:6-7,38-40 calls parsePrefixedAddress/isValidAddress directly and never uses resolveScannedAddress. The test mocks match what the hook actually calls, and the file isn't in the diff.

issues.summary: Focus effect re-activates the camera behind an error overlay in ScanQrSend
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: ScanQrSend.container.tsx at HEAD has no error overlay: errors are toasts (showInvalidAddressToast, :67) and there's no ScanErrorOverlay in components/Camera. The camera/overlay disagreement described can't happen.

issues.summary: Same overlay/focus mismatch in ImportReadOnly useScan
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: ImportReadOnly/hooks/useScan/index.ts:19-30 has no error-message state or overlay (it uses a toast at :50), and the file is unchanged by the PR.

issues.summary: handledRef in useWalletConnectScan is never reset
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: grep finds no handledRef or onAddressScanned under features/WalletConnect at HEAD, and useWalletConnectScan isn't in the diff. The code this finding describes doesn't exist.

issues.summary: The expo-router mock exports only useRouter
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: useScannedAddressToSend.ts:2 imports only useRouter, and tests/test-utils.tsx doesn't import expo-router, so the mock at test:8-10 is enough.

issues.summary: New hook is comment-heavy compared with its siblings
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: useScannedAddressToSend.ts has 11 comment lines, while sibling hooks have 0-5. AGENTS.md discourages unneeded comments, but this is style (the factual inaccuracy is covered separately).

issues.summary: Import skips the Camera barrel for useCameraPermissionFlow
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: ScanQrSend.container.tsx:7 is an unchanged pre-existing line. The barrel at components/Camera/index.ts does export it, and ScanQrAccount.container.tsx uses the same direct path. It's a pure style inconsistency.

issues.summary: Test hardcodes an address literal instead of using faker
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: useScannedAddressToSend.test.tsx:4 hardcodes a checksummed address. A fixed known-valid checksummed value is reasonable for resolveScannedAddress assertions, so this is only a convention preference.

issues.summary: Date.now() scanTimestamp could collide within one millisecond
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: useScannedAddressToSend.ts:64 keeps the pre-existing Date.now() behaviour. The hasScanned guard at ScanQrSend.container.tsx:59,72 stops a second navigation, so a same-millisecond collision is practically unreachable.
